title: Clio Coder knob registry
description: Every flag, key, argument, and constant that changes what Clio Coder does. Held against the source tree by the knob-registry check in scripts/check-hygiene.ts; rendered to docs/knobs.md by `npm run knobs`.

constantScopes.description: Source files whose top-level numeric constants (except *_VERSION) must all be registered.

toolArgScopes.description: Tool names whose argument schemas must be fully registered.

name.description: The knob as the surface spells it: the variable, the dotted settings path, the --flag, the file key, the schema path, the frontmatter key, the YAML key path, or the constant identifier.

owner.description: The command (flags) or domain (everything else) that owns the knob.

command.description: Flags only: the subcommand that parses it, or `global` for a startup flag.

file.description: project-file only: the path under .clio-coder/ the key lives in.

source.description: constant only: the source file that declares it.

class.description: tool-arg only: whether the argument is a policy knob or the task payload.

default.description: What applies when nothing sets the knob. For settings and constants the check holds it against the code.

controls.description: One sentence: what the knob changes and the values it takes.

precedence.description: What beats what when several surfaces set the same value, most powerful first.

verdict.description: keep; merge into `mergeWith`; deprecate behind a warning in favour of `mergeWith`; document (kept, and this row is its only documentation); remove.

mergeWith.description: For merge and deprecate: the canonical knob.

pattern.description: A regular expression that matches every source-side spelling of a family (`CLIO_CODER_HOOK_BUDGET_<PHASE>_MS`).

note.description: Evidence for the verdict or anything the row cannot say in `controls`.
